mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (ledger_id, user_id, account_id, category_id, type_id, amount, remark, transaction_date) VALUES (#{ledgerId}, #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{categoryId}, #{typeId}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{transactionDate})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.amount, t.remark, t.transaction_date, t.created_at, c.name as category_name, c.icon as category_icon, c.color as category_color, ct.name as type_name, a.name as account_name, a.icon as account_icon FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id JOIN category_types ct ON t.type_id = ct.id JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_date LIKE #{monthPrefix} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM transactions t JOIN category_types ct ON t.type_id = ct.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.name = #{type} AND t.transaction_date LIKE #{monthPrefix}

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.color, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) as total FROM categories c JOIN transactions t ON c.id = t.category_id JOIN category_types ct ON t.type_id = ct.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.name = 'expense' AND t.transaction_date LIKE #{yearPrefix} GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT t.transaction_date, ct.name as type_name, c.name as category_name, a.name as account_name, CASE WHEN ct.name = 'income' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END as amount, t.remark FROM transactions t JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id JOIN category_types ct ON t.type_id = ct.id JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.transaction_date LIKE #{yearPrefix} ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC
